segment_captions.caption: C skates forward while pulling a sled with a child sitting on it. The child in the sled is wearing a red jacket and blue pants. A woman stands behind them, watching.

A child in a red jacket sits on a sled while another child in a green jacket skates behind them. A woman in a black jacket and yellow pants stands nearby, watching. The child in the red jacket adjusts their position on the sled.
C pulls a sled with a child sitting on it while another child skates ahead. A man stands nearby watching.
C watches children ice skate on frozen waterway; child in pink jacket skates past C; child in green jacket continues skating ahead.
